heading: Everything your customer sees, and everything your team uses.
intro: People decide what they think of a business long before they buy. They see an ad, open your Instagram, land on your site, fill in a form and wait for a reply. Meanwhile your team works in tools that slow them down. I design and build both sides, so the outside looks serious and the inside runs smoothly.
xrayLeadIn: Here's every place a customer meets your business, from the first ad to the tools your team uses behind the scenes. Tap a step to see what it's for and how I approach it.

touchpoints.name: The ad
touchpoints.body: Often the first thing anyone sees. I make it look like it comes from a real brand, so the click already trusts you.

touchpoints.name: Your social profile
touchpoints.body: Where people go to check you're real. A clear bio, a consistent look and posts that match what you sell.

touchpoints.name: The website
touchpoints.body: Your home on the internet. One clear story, real proof near the top, and fast on a phone.

touchpoints.name: The landing page
touchpoints.body: One page, one offer, one action. Nothing on it competes with the thing you want people to do.

touchpoints.name: The form or checkout
touchpoints.body: The moment someone commits. Few questions, clear steps and no surprises.

touchpoints.name: Booking and confirmation
touchpoints.body: On brand, with a short reminder of what happens next, so people actually show up.

touchpoints.name: Emails and reminders
touchpoints.body: Written to sound like a person and designed to be read on a phone.

touchpoints.name: Decks and proposals
touchpoints.body: What you send or present when it matters. Simple, clean and in the order people ask questions.

touchpoints.name: Onboarding
touchpoints.body: The first days after someone buys. A guided start that makes them glad they did.

touchpoints.name: Your content
touchpoints.body: Reels, carousels and posts that look like one brand, not ten different designers.

touchpoints.name: Reviews and proof
touchpoints.body: Results organised so new customers find stories like their own.

touchpoints.name: The tools your team uses
touchpoints.body: Dashboards, internal apps and AI workflows built around how you actually work.

xrayOutro: Most businesses have properly designed two or three of these. The rest were built in a hurry and never looked at again. Fixing them doesn't need a new product or a bigger ad budget, just someone who pays attention to all twelve.

capabilities.title: Brand and identity.
capabilities.body: Logos, type, colour and a small system so everything looks like it came from the same place.

capabilities.title: Websites and landing pages.
capabilities.body: Designed and built in Framer, Webflow or code, fast, responsive and easy for your team to edit.

capabilities.title: Custom software.
capabilities.body: Internal tools, dashboards and full apps that replace spreadsheets and juggling five tools.

capabilities.title: AI tools and automation.
capabilities.body: Assistants, workflows and small apps that save your team hours every week.

capabilities.title: Ads and social content.
capabilities.body: Static ads, carousels and post templates that look like a serious brand.

capabilities.title: Video and motion.
capabilities.body: Reels, launch videos and small animations that make things feel finished.

capabilities.title: Decks, PDFs and lead magnets.
capabilities.body: Playbooks, guides and pitch decks that look worth paying for.

capabilities.title: Copy.
capabilities.body: I write the words too, because a well designed page with weak copy is still a weak page.
